title: Croatian Stew Vegan Version
description: A hearty, comforting stew with a twist, made vegan by substituting traditional meats with tofu.

ingredients.name: Croatian stew spice mix
ingredients.notes: Available in most international grocery stores or online

ingredients.name: Red wine (optional)
ingredients.notes: Use a vegan red wine or omit

instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the kickin and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth, tomato paste, stew spice mix, and tofu.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
